title: Noddaango ngo heɗaaka e nder leydi mawnikinaare
intro: Aɗa darii e ŋoral siwil mawɗo meeɗnooɗo wonde, ɗo doole e mawnikinaare nganndaano keeri. Nelaaɗo ina yaha hakkunde maɓɓe ina nodda goonga kono ɓerɗe maɓɓe ina tiiɗi. Jeertinaango ngoo yahraani no haanirta nii, asamaan oo e hoore mum wonti kuutorgal tikkere. Hol oo nulaaɗo, hol ko woni saliiɓe noddaango ngoo?
clues: Mi neldaama e leñol ngol doole mum ngalaa ɗo kaaɗi, ngol mahi e kala nokku toowɗo monimaaji.
Yimɓe am ina cikki koye mum en ina mbaawi foolde, ina mbiya hol ɓurɗo en semmbe?
Mi noddiibe yo 6e ndew Alla tan, kono be tuumimi ko mi majjere e fenaande.
Ɓe ndartini mi ngam addude jukkungo ngo fodaniino mi so tawii ko mi goonga.
Alla neli e dow ma66e henndu ndu 6uu6ndu ndu 6uu6naani hay huunde nde ndu ari e dow ma66e.
Miin e gooŋɗinɓe wonduɓe e am ɓee, min ndañaama e yurmeende Alla, heeferɓe ɓee ngalaa haa laaɓi cer.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Huudu e goondinoo6e ndasiima, heefer6e ndummbaa
Huudu wari ɗum ko lenyol mum
Huudu woppi leñol mum ko adii kala jukkungo
outcome.answer: Huudu e goondinoo6e ndasiima, heefer6e ndummbaa

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
